Subject: POC trial RACI & kickoff: HorizonCare - success criteria + owners

Hi Sofia / Jamal — great to meet with you both this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Call highlights / proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency under 350ms for standard queries (avg seq len ~150 tokens)
- Throughput: support 10 concurrent inference sessions (burst to 30) during clinical-surge scenarios
- Quality: intents mapped correctly > 92% on our eval set of 250 prompts, no PII leakage
- Integration: embeddings & metadata sync to your search layer within 2s for updates

Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Week of Jun 22: 2-week trial environment provisioned (Redwood hosted dedicated pool)
- Week 1: integration + smoke tests (connectors, auth, sample prompts)
- Week 2: workload run + quality evaluation against provided prompt set; share results and decision input

Who we need from HorizonCare to make this flow smoothly (please confirm owner & contact):
- Infra / network owner (VPN, VPC, firewall rules)
- App / product owner (integration, sample flows, success criteria sign-off)
- Security / compliance reviewer (SOC2, data handling)
- Procurement / contracting lead (SOW, MOP signature, timeline for PO)

Attached: horizoncare-poc-mop-v1.pdf (draft MOP) and a blank RACI template (raci-template.xlsx).

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm owners for the four areas above
2) Confirm kickoff: Jun 22, 10:00 AM PT for provisioning + integration plan
3) Sign MOP (DocuSign link to follow)

If that all looks right I’ll send a calendar invite and kick off the provisioning ticket with our infra team.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
